points.K5: 从背规则到懂原则、会评估
points.K6: 本课程不能代替本实验室培训
points.S1: 安全第一、预防为主、综合治理

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣穿实验服、戴护目镜，站在大学实验楼门口向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot in a white lab coat and safety goggles stands at the entrance of a university laboratory building and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到高校实验室安全课。
overlay: 课程导学：从规则到风险管理

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现三个图标：问号、书本、路线箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gestures to three floating icons beside it: a question mark, an open book, and a winding path arrow.
shots.narration: 这一课先说为什么学、学什么、怎么学。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰第一次走进化学实验室，东张西望，伸手去摸台面上的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a lab coat walks into a chemistry lab for the first time, looks around curiously and reaches toward a reagent bottle on the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天进实验室，什么都想摸。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指向门边一块空白的安全信息牌
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and goggles gently stops him and points to a blank safety information board beside the door.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先看看这里的安全须知。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a puzzled look, a question mark bubble above him.
shots.narration: 阿杰嘀咕：这些规则高中就背过了。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前严肃地摇了摇手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and wags one finger with a serious face.
shots.narration: 背过规则，不等于真的会安全。

shots.section_title: 实验室事故离我们不远
shots.scene: 一叠空白报纸和翻动的日历图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a stack of blank newspapers next to a calendar with pages flipping. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室事故，每年都在发生。
overlay: 实验室事故离我们不远

shots.section_title: 实验室事故离我们不远
shots.scene: 四个图标排成一行：打翻的烧杯、注射针头、细菌、火焰
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a tipped-over beaker with a spill, a syringe needle, a germ, and a flame with a small burst. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒、针刺、感染、火灾爆炸都常见。

shots.section_title: 实验室事故离我们不远
shots.scene: 救护车图标和红十字图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ambulance next to a red cross symbol with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 严重时，会致伤致残甚至死亡。

shots.section_title: 实验室事故离我们不远
shots.scene: 欣欣站在校园实验楼前，神情认真
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a campus lab building with a serious expression.
shots.narration: 它不是偶然个例，就在我们身边。

shots.section_title: 安全是科研的地基
shots.scene: 一张打满勾的空白检查表，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist covered with tick marks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 安全不是为了应付检查打勾。

shots.section_title: 安全是科研的地基
shots.scene: 一座小楼建在厚实的地基上，地基发光
shots.prompt_en: A simple building sitting on a thick glowing foundation slab, with small flask and chart icons on its floors. No people.
shots.narration: 它像地基，托起所有的科研活动。

shots.section_title: 安全是科研的地基
shots.scene: 三个相扣的圆环图标
shots.prompt_en: Three interlocking rings icon, each ring holding a simple symbol: a shield, a check badge, and a bar chart. No people.
shots.narration: 安全、质量、数据，三者分不开。

shots.section_title: 每次实验押上的四样东西
shots.scene: 天平一端是烧瓶，另一端是四个图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a flask on one pan and four small icons on the other pan: a heart, a microscope, a sample tube, and a university building. No people.
shots.narration: 每次实验，都同时押上四样东西。
overlay: 每次实验押上的四样东西

shots.section_title: 每次实验押上的四样东西
shots.scene: 心形图标里有一个小人
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a red heart with a small person pictogram inside. No people.
shots.narration: 第一样，是人的生命和健康。

shots.section_title: 每次实验押上的四样东西
shots.scene: 显微镜、离心机图标和样品管、数据表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a microscope and a centrifuge next to a rack of sample tubes and a blank data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 还有仪器设备，和样品数据。

shots.section_title: 每次实验押上的四样东西
shots.scene: 大学楼图标上挂着一把锁
shots.prompt_en: A university building icon with a padlock hanging on its door. No people.
shots.narration: 以及单位继续做科研的资格。

shots.section_title: 每次实验押上的四样东西
shots.scene: 实验室里几位同学各自做实验，彼此相邻
shots.prompt_en: Several students in lab coats and goggles work at neighboring benches in a shared lab.
shots.narration: 同一间实验室，每个人都和你相关。

shots.section_title: 事故的代价远不止医药费
shots.scene: 一张账单图标，旁边是医药箱和硬币
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blank bill next to a medical kit and a stack of coins. No people.
shots.narration: 事故的损失，远不止医药费。
overlay: 事故的代价远不止医药费

shots.section_title: 事故的代价远不止医药费
shots.scene: 冰山露出水面的一角，上面是药瓶和钱袋图标
shots.prompt_en: An iceberg with a small tip above the water; on the tip sit a medicine bottle icon and a money bag icon. No people.
shots.narration: 医疗费、赔偿金，是直接成本。

shots.section_title: 事故的代价远不止医药费
shots.scene: 冰山水下的大块，里面是停工、放大镜、时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: The large underwater part of the iceberg showing a stopped gear, a magnifying glass, and a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 停工、调查、误工，是间接成本。

shots.section_title: 事故的代价远不止医药费
shots.scene: 封着条的实验室门，台面上的样品管被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab door taped shut with barrier tape, and a rack of sample tubes on a bench marked with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 在高校，还有实验停摆、样品报废。

shots.section_title: 事故的代价远不止医药费
shots.scene: 学位帽图标旁的日历被拉长
shots.prompt_en: A graduation cap icon next to a calendar being stretched longer with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 学业延误，还会拖累整个团队。

shots.section_title: 从背规则到懂原则、会评估
shots.scene: 两级台阶，下层是清单图标，上层是灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: Two steps of a staircase: the lower step holds a checklist icon, the upper step holds a glowing light bulb icon. No people.
shots.narration: 高中学过的规则，大学还会再听。
overlay: 从背规则到懂原则、会评估

shots.section_title: 从背规则到懂原则、会评估
shots.scene: 阿杰从下层台阶迈上上层台阶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student steps up from the lower step to the upper step of the staircase.
shots.narration: 这一次，要在规则之上再进一步。

shots.section_title: 从背规则到懂原则、会评估
shots.scene: 一台陌生的新仪器，旁边的规则清单上是问号
shots.prompt_en: An unfamiliar new instrument on a bench beside a blank rule list with a big question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 规则清单，不可能写全所有情况。

shots.section_title: 从背规则到懂原则、会评估
shots.scene: 小研拿放大镜仔细看新仪器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student examines the new instrument closely with a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 懂了原则，遇到新情况也不慌。

shots.section_title: 从背规则到懂原则、会评估
shots.scene: 四个图标排成一行：放大镜、天平、盾牌、急救箱
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a magnifying glass, a balance scale, a shield, and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 认危害、估风险、定措施、备应急。

shots.section_title: 从背规则到懂原则、会评估
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up with a confident smile.
shots.narration: 安全，远不只是遵守规则。

shots.section_title: 安全第一、预防为主、综合治理
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一面盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blue shield with a check mark.
shots.narration: 我国安全工作有一条基本方针。
overlay: 安全第一、预防为主、综合治理

shots.section_title: 安全第一、预防为主、综合治理
shots.scene: 三个图标：盾牌、望远镜、拼图
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a shield, a telescope looking ahead, and interlocking puzzle pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 安全第一，预防为主，综合治理。

shots.section_title: 安全第一、预防为主、综合治理
shots.scene: 左边检查设备打勾，右边救火的场景被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Split image: on the left a hand ticks a blank inspection card beside equipment; on the right a firefighting scene icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 功夫要下在事前，而不是事后补救。

shots.section_title: 安全第一、预防为主、综合治理
shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层图标叠在一起
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked layers of icons: a university building on top, a department building in the middle, a lab room at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 高校实验室，也要落实这条方针。

shots.section_title: 本课程不能代替本实验室培训
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白教材
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank textbook with a friendly face.
shots.narration: 这门课讲要点，帮你打好基础。
overlay: 本课程不能代替本实验室培训

shots.section_title: 本课程不能代替本实验室培训
shots.scene: 王老师在培训室给学生讲课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a small group of students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 系统学习，还要参加学校的培训。

shots.section_title: 本课程不能代替本实验室培训
shots.scene: 【实拍】固定机位拍本校一间实验室门口的安全信息牌，缓慢推近（遮挡人名电话等个人信息）
shots.prompt_en: A lab entrance door with a blank safety information board mounted beside it, camera slowly zooming in. No people.
shots.narration: 到了实验室，还要学本室规程。

shots.section_title: 本课程不能代替本实验室培训
shots.scene: 【实拍】实验室内横移镜头，依次扫过洗眼器、紧急喷淋和墙上的灭火器（无人、无品牌标识）
shots.prompt_en: A slow pan inside a lab past an eyewash station, an emergency shower and a red fire extinguisher on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 认清身边的洗眼器和灭火器。

shots.section_title: 本课程不能代替本实验室培训
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周请教，老周耐心讲解
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man a question; the older man explains patiently, pointing at the bench.
shots.narration: 拿不准，就问负责人和老师。

shots.section_title: 课程地图与学习方法
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一张展开的路线地图前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a large unfolded route map with a dotted path and milestones.
shots.narration: 这门课共十五章，像一张地图。

shots.section_title: 课程地图与学习方法
shots.scene: 地图前段四个图标：天平、放大镜、护目镜、灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The first part of the map shows four icons: a balance scale, a magnifying glass, safety goggles, and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 先学管理与通识，人人必修。

shots.section_title: 课程地图与学习方法
shots.scene: 地图中段五个图标：试剂瓶、细菌、辐射三叶形、闪电、激光束
shots.prompt_en: The middle part of the map shows five icons: a reagent bottle, a germ, an ionizing radiation trefoil, a lightning bolt, and a laser beam. No people.
shots.narration: 再按你的实验，选学专项危害。

shots.section_title: 课程地图与学习方法
shots.scene: 地图末段：急救箱和工具箱图标
shots.prompt_en: The last part of the map shows a first aid kit icon and a toolbox icon. No people.
shots.narration: 最后是应急处置和实验基本技能。

shots.section_title: 课程地图与学习方法
shots.scene: 三个图标：播放键、打开的书、铅笔和勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a play button, an open book, and a pencil with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 看视频，读说明书，做课后练习。

shots.section_title: 课程地图与学习方法
shots.scene: 阿杰坐在桌前边听课边记笔记，抬头想自己的实验
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a desk taking notes, then looks up thinking about his own experiment.
shots.narration: 边学边想：我的实验有哪些危害？

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在三个图标旁：警示三角、地基、灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a warning triangle, a building foundation, and a light bulb.
shots.narration: 事故不远，安全是科研的地基。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 阿杰和小研一起走上台阶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student walk up the staircase together.
shots.narration: 从背规则，走向懂原则、会评估。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 教材图标和实验室门图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A blank textbook icon side by side with a lab door icon, linked by a plus sign. No people.
shots.narration: 课程打基础，本室规程不能少。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在实验楼门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the entrance of the university laboratory building.
shots.narration: 下一课，看实验室安全的法律法规。
